name: Detail Macro
description: Close-up macro photography with enhanced details
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only change the camera perspective to extreme close-up macro view, background to softly blurred, and lighting to focused directional lighting. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only modify the environment (background, lighting, camera perspective) around the unchanged product.

objects.description: The exact product from the input image, preserved as-is, shown in extreme close-up revealing intricate details
objects.orientation: angled to showcase texture and craftsmanship details
objects.relationship: Primary subject filling frame with intimate detail, overwhelming presence
objects.relative_size: very large within frame, macro perspective
objects.shape_and_color: Natural colors with high contrast and exceptional clarity
objects.texture: Highly detailed, textured surface with visible fine details, pores, weave, or material structure
objects.appearance_details: Exceptional sharpness revealing intricate craftsmanship, material quality, stitching, grain, or surface characteristics

background_setting: Softly blurred background (bokeh) to emphasize product details and create depth separation

lighting.direction: angled light from 30-45 degrees to enhance texture, dimension, and surface details
lighting.shadows: deep, intentional shadows creating dramatic depth, contrast, and three-dimensionality

photographic_characteristics.camera_angle: extreme close-up macro perspective, intimate viewpoint
photographic_characteristics.depth_of_field: very shallow, razor-thin focus plane with beautiful bokeh
photographic_characteristics.focus: extreme sharpness on specific product detail or texture area
photographic_characteristics.lens_focal_length: macro lens (100mm macro or specialized macro lens)

aesthetics.composition: tight, intimate macro framing with detail as focal point
aesthetics.color_scheme: natural colors with high contrast and rich tonal range

context: Detail-focused product photography for highlighting craftsmanship, quality, and material excellence in luxury and premium products
